008package paint.shared.io;
009
010import paint.shared.objects.Experiment;
011import paint.shared.objects.Recording;
012import paint.shared.objects.Square;
013import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
014import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
015
016import java.nio.file.Path;
017import java.util.List;
018
019import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.readTracksTable;
020import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.readRecordings;
021import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.readSquaresTable;
022import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.trackTableToList;
023import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.squareTableToList;
024
025import static paint.shared.utils.SharedSquareUtils.filterTracksInSquare;
026
027import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.RECORDINGS_CSV;
028import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.TRACKS_CSV;
029import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.SQUARES_CSV;
030
031import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
032
033/**
034 * Provides centralized functionality for loading experiment-related data:
035 * recordings, optionally tracks, and optionally squares.
036 */
037public final class ExperimentDataLoader {
038
039    private ExperimentDataLoader() {}
040
041    /**
042     * Loads an experiment with flexible inclusion of tracks and squares.
043     *
044     *
045     * @param projectPath     the root project directory
046     * @param experimentName  the name of the experiment folder
047     * @param loadSquares     whether to include squares (mature project mode)
048     * @param loadTracks      whether to include track data
049     * @return an {@link Experiment} with requested data layers loaded, or {@code null} on failure
050     */
051    public static Experiment loadExperiment(Path    projectPath,
052            String  experimentName,
053            boolean loadSquares,
054            boolean loadTracks) {
055
056        Path experimentPath   = projectPath.resolve(experimentName);
057        Experiment experiment = new Experiment(experimentName);
058
059        // ─── Recordings ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
060        List<Recording> recordings;
061        try {
062            recordings = readRecordings(experimentPath);
063            for (Recording recording : recordings) {
064                experiment.addRecording(recording);
065            }
066        } catch (Exception e) {
067            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to read %s in %s", RECORDINGS_CSV, experimentName);
068            return null;
069        }
070
071        // ─── Tracks (optional) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
072        Table         tracksTable = null;
073
074        if (loadTracks) {
075            try {
076                tracksTable = readTracksTable(experimentPath);
077            } catch (Exception e) {
078                PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to read %s in %s", TRACKS_CSV, experimentName);
079                return null;
080            }
081
082            // readTracksTable can return null without throwing. Report that as the documented
083            // "could not load" result rather than dereferencing it and dying with an NPE.
084            if (tracksTable == null) {
085                PaintLogger.errorf("No %s content in %s", TRACKS_CSV, experimentName);
086                return null;
087            }
088
089            PaintLogger.debugf("Found %d tracks", tracksTable.rowCount());
090
091            for (Recording recording : recordings) {
092                if (!recording.isProcessFlagSet()) {
093                    continue;
094                }
095
096                Table recTracksTable = tracksTable.where(
097                        tracksTable.stringColumn(RECORDING_NAME)
098                                   .isEqualTo(recording.getRecordingName()));
099
100                PaintLogger.debugf("Found %d tracks for recording '%s'",
101                                   recTracksTable.rowCount(), recording.getRecordingName());
102
103                recording.setTracksList(trackTableToList(recTracksTable));
104                recording.setTracksTable(recTracksTable);
105            }
106        }
107
108        // ─── Squares (optional) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
109        if (loadSquares) {
110            Table squaresTable;
111            try {
112                squaresTable = readSquaresTable(experimentPath);
113            } catch (Exception e) {
114                PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to read %s in %s", SQUARES_CSV, experimentName);
115                return null;
116            }
117
118            int numberOfRecordingsToProcess =
119                    (int) recordings.stream()
120                                    .filter(Recording::isProcessFlagSet)
121                                    .count();
122            int numberOfSquares             = squaresTable.rowCount();
123            int numberOfSquaresPerRecording = (numberOfRecordingsToProcess == 0) ? 0 : numberOfSquares / numberOfRecordingsToProcess;
124
125            int numberOfRows = (numberOfSquaresPerRecording > 0)
126                    ? (int) Math.round(Math.sqrt(numberOfSquaresPerRecording))
127                    : 0;
128
129            if (numberOfRows > 0 && numberOfRows * numberOfRows != numberOfSquaresPerRecording) {
130                // Log the condition; do NOT show a dialog here. This I/O method runs
131                // headless and on worker threads, where a modal dialog would hang or
132                // throw. UI notification, if desired, belongs in the UI layer.
133                PaintLogger.errorf("Invalid squares layout in experiment '%s'", experimentName);
134            }
135
136            for (Recording rec : recordings) {
137                Table recSquares = squaresTable.where(
138                        squaresTable.stringColumn(RECORDING_NAME)
139                                    .matchesRegex("^" + rec.getRecordingName() + "(?:-threshold-\\d{1,3})?$"));
140
141                rec.addSquares(squareTableToList(recSquares));
142
143                // Only map tracks into squares if tracks were loaded
144                if (loadTracks && numberOfRows > 0) {
145                    int   lastRowCol = numberOfRows - 1;
146                    Table recTracks  = rec.getTracksTable();
147
148                    for (Square square : rec.getSquaresOfRecording()) {
149                        Table SquaresTracks = filterTracksInSquare(recTracks, square, lastRowCol);
150                        square.setTracksList(trackTableToList(SquaresTracks));
151                    }
152                }
153            }
154        }
155
156        return experiment;
157    }
158}
